lines.text: Tap the table: one-two—kitchen picture beat!
We name the safe picture clues; real hot and sharp tools stay with grown-ups.
A—Apple! Apple round and bright | skin and core are picture clues in sight
B ... B ... Blender. A blender is a powered appliance with fast-moving blades used by a grown-up to mix or puree food.
Cup steps in for C. It is a small open container used for drinking or measuring.
What does D reveal? Donut! A donut is a baked or fried pastry often shaped like a ring or filled round.
across the safe kitchen-picture table, E meets Egg. Egg, oval shell | white and yolk are tucked in well
F—Fork! It is an eating utensil with several narrow tines.
G ... G ... Grapes. Grapes are small round or oval fruits that grow in bunches on vines.
Honey steps in for H. It is a thick sweet liquid made by honeybees from flower nectar.
Picture first, safe hands—A-B-C!
Kitchen words, come name with me!
What does I reveal? Ice Tray! Ice Tray in the frame | food or tool details tell its name
across the safe kitchen-picture table, J meets Juicer. It is a tool or appliance made to separate juice from fruit or vegetables.
K—Knife! A kitchen knife has a sharp blade for cutting food and is a grown-up tool in this preschool picture activity.
L ... L ... Ladle. A ladle is a long-handled spoon with a deep bowl for serving liquids.
Muffin steps in for M. Muffin in the frame | food or tool details tell its name
What does N reveal? Napkin! A napkin is a piece of cloth or paper used to wipe hands or the mouth during a meal.
across the safe kitchen-picture table, O meets Oven. It is an enclosed appliance that cooks food with heat; a grown-up operates it because surfaces can become very hot.
P—Pan! It is a cooking vessel with a broad bottom; heated pans are handled by grown-ups.
Q ... Q ... Quart Cup. Quart Cup in the frame | food or tool details tell its name
Rice steps in for R. It is a small grain that becomes soft as it cooks in water.
What does S reveal? Spoon! A spoon has a small rounded bowl on a handle for scooping or stirring.
across the safe kitchen-picture table, T meets Toast. It is bread browned by dry heat.
Picture first, safe hands—A-B-C!
Kitchen words, come name with me!
U—Under-counter Drawer! Under-counter Drawer on display | shape or kitchen job gives the clue today
V ... V ... Vegetable Peeler. A vegetable peeler has a sharp slot blade that removes thin strips of peel and is used with adult supervision.
Waffle steps in for W. Waffle on display | little grid marks cross it every way
What does X reveal? Xylophone! A xylophone is a musical instrument, not a kitchen tool; its bars make pitched notes when struck.
across the safe kitchen-picture table, Y meets Yam. Yam in the frame | food or tool details tell its name
Z—Zester! It has small sharp edges that scrape thin fragrant pieces from citrus peel and is a grown-up tool in this activity.
The picture table goes quiet; hands are empty. Now remember the kitchen words.
A ... Apple! Point, then make one small shape gesture.
Remember B ... Blender! Point only; mime with empty hands while a grown-up handles the real tool.
